about.title: One project at a time.
body: Romack Home Maintenance Services, also known as Rowmack Inc., is me, Vacaville handyman Robert "Bob" Mackert. I have over 25 years of experience, and if your project involves wood and/or houses, my list of skills goes on, from simple to custom.
I respond fast, often the same day, show up on time, charge fair prices and clean up behind myself. Many customers call me back for project after project around the house.

reviews.text: He is the best handyman I’ve ever hired. Very professional and kind. We are very satisfied.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I am absolutely thrilled to write a review for Robert, who recently installed a ceiling fan in my home. From start to finish, the experience was nothing short of exceptional. Robert is the epitome of professionalism. He arrived precisely on time, which I greatly appreciate, and immediately got to work. Beyond his punctuality, his demeanor was incredibly pleasant, and he even had a great sense of humor that made the whole process enjoyable. What truly set Robert apart was his keen eye and observant nature. He noticed a small detail about the wiring that could have caused an issue down the line…
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: My husband text Bob, today Sunday March 2, 2025 to replace a shower head in one of our bathrooms. Bob, responded immediately and said that he’d be out today, he arrived within the hour and replaced the shower head within a few minutes. He’s quick, reasonably priced and more importantly, he cleans up behind himself. We use Bob on a regular basis for various repairs around the house.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Bob is very helpful, very affordable and upfront. I called and he showed up within an hour and a half. I had one project that I called him out for, but after having him look at the main project, I intend on using his services for all of my other projects that need to be taken care of.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I called ROWMACK today and spoke with Robert Mackert. I will be working from home starting tomorrow and my desk was still in the box!!! Bob came to my house and within an hour my desk was complete. He is also very nice. So if you need someone to put your furniture together, please call my new handy man at ROWMACK INC! Trust me, you will be glad you did!!!
reviews.author: BestProsInTown reviewer

reviews.text: Robert responded the same day. He arrived on time and went to work. Completed task in a reasonable time and charged a fair fee for a difficult job. Cleaned up his work area. I am very pleased and would not hesitate to hire him again.
reviews.author: BestProsInTown reviewer

reviews.text: Bob is an excellent worker. Shows up when he says he will and makes sure whatever he is working on is repaired correctly. We’ve had three different people work on our door, but they never fixed it. Bob put in the time to make sure it was done correctly. He is reasonable in his pricing and very kind. We will definitely be using his services in the future!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Bob of Rowmack Inc Handyman Services did a side garage door install. He knew exactly what was required to start and finish the project in a timely matter. His professional talent produced outstanding results. I am more than pleased with his work. I have already ask Bob to schedule me in for another install in the kitchen. Highly Recommended
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Such great service received today. I found Bob's information while searching for someone to install my over the range microwave. I reached out to Bob and he was very responsive and was able to get me all set up this morning. Bob even recommended an earlier time. I really can say what quality work and Bob hauled away the old appliance as well. I will recommend Bob to anyone and even make use of him again for other things needed to be done in my house. If I could have given 10 stars I would.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Bob knows his stuff! He did an awesome job installing our lament flooring and baseboards, he also was so fast at texturing my ceilings, and did some great electrical work for us. I love how flexible he is with our schedule and overall really fun to work with, I would highly recommend for any construction job!

faq.q: Is Romack the same as Rowmack Inc.?
faq.a: Yes, that's me. I'm Robert "Bob" Mackert, and my business goes by both Romack Home Maintenance Services and Rowmack Inc.

faq.q: What kinds of jobs do you take?
faq.a: Sheetrock repair and texturing, doors, laminate flooring and baseboards, furniture assembly, carpentry, dry rot repair, caulking, plumbing fixture swaps, ceiling fans and appliance installs. If it involves wood and/or houses, ask.

faq.q: How quickly can you come out?
faq.a: Often fast. I can often respond the same day, sometimes within an hour or an hour and a half.
I don't post prices online, but I keep my pricing fair, affordable and upfront. Call or text me at (707) 317-8126 to describe your project.
I work Monday–Friday 7 AM–6 PM and Saturday 9 AM–3 PM. Closed Sunday.

faq.q: How much experience do you have?
faq.a: I have over 25 years of experience.
